packageRules.description: Held at 0.2.0: patches/next-navigation-guard@0.2.0.patch is keyed to that exact version, and bun silently skips a patch whose key does not match the resolved version. Any bump must re-create the patch first. The patch can be dropped once https://github.com/LayerXcom/next-navigation-guard/pull/61 is merged and released, and that PR also needs to cover the createHandlePopState deref in useInterceptPopState.
